segments.documentTitle: Adding Audio Unit Auxiliary Real-Time Threads to Audio Workgroups

segments.normalizedSource: ```objc #import <AudioToolbox/AudioToolbox.h> -(AURenderContextObserver)renderContextObserver { // Create block safe pointer to kernel. __block AUKernel *kernel = _kernel; /* The system calls this block on the render thread, immediately before any render request. */ return ^ (const AudioUnitRenderContext *context) { if (auto renderContext = context) { kernel->workgroupDidChange(renderContext->workgroup); } else { /** The new workgroup may be null in the case of a nonreal-time render context, or a real-time thread that is not part of any workgroup. */ kernel->removeAllWorkgroups(); } }; } ```
segments.contextBefore: When the context’s audio workgroup changes, join your auxiliary real-time threads to the new audio workgroup.
